H6403.def: a primitive root; to slip out, i.e. escape; causatively, to deliver:--calve, carry away safe, deliver, (cause to) escape.

H6404.def: from «06403»; escape; Pelet, the name of two Israelites:--Pelet. See also «01046».

H6406.def: from «06403»; delivered; Palti, the name of two Israelites:--Palti, Phalti.

H6407.def: patronymically from «06406»; a Paltite or descendant of Palti:--Paltite.

H6409.def: from the same as «06404» and «0410»; deliverance of God; Paltiel, the name of two Israelites:--Paltiel, Phaltiel.

H6410.def: or Platyahuw {pel-at-yaw'-hoo}; from «06403» and «03050»; Jah has delivered; Pelatjah, the name of four Israelites:--Pelatiah.

H6411.def: or Pla.yah {pel-aw-yaw'}; from «06381» and «03050»; Jah has distinguished; Pelajah, the name of three Israelites:--Pelaiah.

H6412.def: or paleyt {paw-late'}; or palet {paw-late'}; from «06403»; a refugee:--(that have) escape(-d, -th), fugitive.

H6413.def: or pletah {pel-ay-taw'}; feminine of «06412»; deliverance; concretely, an escaped portion:--deliverance, (that is) escape(-d), remnant.

H6418.et: from an unused root meaning to be round
H6418.def: from an unused root meaning to be round; a circuit (i.e. district); also a spindle (as whirled); hence, a crutch:--(di-)staff, participle

H6419.def: a primitive root; to judge (officially or mentally); by extension, to intercede, pray:--intreat, judge(-ment), (make) pray(-er, -ing), make supplication.

H6421.def: from «06419» and «03050»; Jah has judged; Pelaljah, an Israelite:--Pelaliah.

H6422.def: probably for «06423»; a certain one, i.e. so-and-so:--certain.

H6423.def: from «06395»; such a one, i.e. a specified peccrson:--such.

H6424.def: a primitive root; properly, to roll flat, i.e. prepare (a road); also to revolve, i.e. weigh (mentally):--make, ponder, weigh.

H6426.def: a primitive root; properly, perhaps to rend, i.e. (by implication) to quiver:--tremble.

H6428.def: a primitive root; to roll (in dust):--roll (wallow) self.

H6429.def: from «06428»; rolling, i.e. migratory; Pelesheth, a region of Syria:--Palestina, Palestine, Philistia, Philistines.

H6430.def: patrial from «06429»; a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth:--Philistine.

H6431.et: from an unused root meaning to flee
H6431.def: from an unused root meaning to flee; swiftness; Peleth, the name of two Israelites:--Peleth.

H6432.def: from the same form as «06431»; a courier (collectively) or official messenger:--Pelethites.

H6433.def: (Aramaic) probably for «06310»; the mouth (literally or figuratively):--mouth.

H6434.et: from an unused root meaning to turn
H6434.def: from an unused root meaning to turn; an angle (of a street or wall):--corner.

H6435.def: from «06437»; properly, removal; used only (in the construction) adverb as conjunction, lest:--(lest) (peradventure), that...not.

H6437.def: a primitive root; to turn; by implication, to face, i.e. appear, look, etc.:--appear, at (even-)tide, behold, cast out, come on, × corner, dawning, empty, go away, lie, look, mark, pass away, prepare, regard, (have) respect (to), (re-)turn (aside, away, back, face, self), × right (early).

H6438.def: feminine of «06434»; an angle; by implication, a pinnacle; figuratively, a chieftain:--bulwark, chief, corner, stay, tower.

H6439.def: or (more properly,) Pniylel {pen-oo-ale'}; from «06437» and «0410»; face of God; Penuel or Peniel, a place East of Jordan; also (as Penuel) the name of two Israelites:--Peniel, Penuel.

H6440.def: plural (but always as singular) of an unused noun (paneh {paw-neh'}; from «06437»); the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.):--+ accept, a-(be- )fore(-time), against, anger, × as (long as), at, + battle, + because (of), + beseech, countenance, edge, + employ, endure, + enquire, face, favour, fear of, for, forefront(-part), form(-er time, -ward), from, front, heaviness, × him(-self), + honourable, + impudent, + in, it, look(-eth) (- s), × me, + meet, × more than, mouth, of, off, (of) old (time), × on, open, + out of, over against, the partial, person, + please, pres

H6441.def: from «06440» with directive enclitic; faceward, i.e. indoors:--(with-)in(-ner part, -ward).

H6443.def: or paniy {paw-nee'}; from the same as «06434»; probably a pearl (as round):--ruby.

H6444.def: probably feminine from «06443» contr.; Peninnah, an Israelitess:--Peninnah.

H6445.def: a primitive root; to enervate:--bring up.

H6446.def: from «06461»; properly, the palm (of the hand) or sole (of the foot) (compare «06447»); by implication (plural) a long and sleeved tunic (perhaps simply a wide one; from the original sense of the root, i.e. of many breadths):--(divers) colours.

H6447.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «06461»; the palm (of the hand, as being spread out):--participle

H6448.def: a primitive root; to cut up, i.e. (figuratively) contemplate:--consider.

H6449.def: from «06448»; a cleft; Pisgah, a mt. East of Jordan:--Pisgah.

H6450.def: from «06446» and the plural of «01818»; palm (i.e. dell) of bloodshed; Pas-Dammim, a place in Palestine:--Pas-dammim. Compare «0658».

H6452.def: a primitive root; to hop, i.e. (figuratively) skip over (or spare); by implication, to hesitate; also (literally) to limp, to dance:--halt, become lame, leap, pass over.

H6453.def: from «06452»; a pretermission, i.e. exemption; used only techically of the Jewish Passover (the festival or the victim):--passover (offering).

H6454.def: from «06452»; limping; Paseach, the name of two Israelites:--Paseah, Phaseah.

H6457.et: from an unused root meaning to divide
H6457.def: from an unused root meaning to divide; divider; Pasak, an Israelite:--Pasach.

H6458.def: a primitive root; to carve, whether wood or stone:--grave, hew.

H6460.et: a transliteration of the Gr psalterion
H6460.def: (Aramaic) or pcanteriyn {pes-an-tay-reen'}; a transliteration of the Gr. psalterion; a lyre:--psaltery.

H6461.def: a primitive root; probably to disperse, i.e. (intransitive) disappear:--cease.

H6462.def: perhaps from «06461»; dispersion; Pispah, an Israelite:--Pispah.

H6464.def: or Pamiy {paw-ee'}; from «06463»; screaming; Pau or Pai, a place in Edom:--Pai, Pau.

H6465.def: from «06473»; a gap; Peor, a mountain East of Jordan; also (for «01187») a deity worshipped there:--Peor. See also «01047».

H6466.def: a primitive root; to do or make (systematically and habitually), especially to practise:--commit, (evil-) do(-er), make(-r), ordain, work(-er).

H6467.def: from «06466»; an act or work (concretely):--act, deed, do, getting, maker, work.

H6468.def: feminine passive participle of «06466»; (abstractly) work:--labour, reward, wages, work.

H6470.def: a primitive root; to tap, i.e. beat regularly; hence (generally) to impel or agitate:--move, trouble.

H6471.def: or (feminine) pa;amah {pah-am-aw'}; from «06470»; a stroke, literally or figuratively (in various applications, as follow):--anvil, corner, foot(-step), going, (hundred-)fold, × now, (this) + once, order, rank, step, + thrice, ((often-)), second, this, two) time(-s), twice, wheel.

H6473.def: a primitive root; to yawn, i.e. open wide (literally or figuratively):--gape, open (wide).

H6475.def: a primitive root; to rend, i.e. open (especially the mouth):--deliver, gape, open, rid, utter.

H6476.def: a primitive root; to break out (in joyful sound):--break (forth, forth into joy), make a loud noise.

H6480.def: a primitive root; to rend (by earthquake):--break.

H6481.def: a primitive root; to split, i.e. wound:--wound.

H6483.et: from an unused root meaning to dissever
H6483.def: from an unused root meaning to dissever; dispersive; Pitstsets, a priest:--Apses (including the article).

H6484.def: a primitive root; to peck at, i.e. (figuratively) stun or dull:--press, urge, stubbornness.

H6485.def: a primitive root; to visit (with friendly or hostile intent); by analogy, to oversee, muster, charge, care for, miss, deposit, etc.:--appoint, × at all, avenge, bestow, (appoint to have the, give a) charge, commit, count, deliver to keep, be empty, enjoin, go see, hurt, do judgment, lack, lay up, look, make, × by any means, miss, number, officer, (make) overseer, have (the) oversight, punish, reckon, (call to) remember(-brance), set (over), sum, × surely, visit, want.

H6486.def: feminine passive participle of «06485»; visitation (in many senses, chiefly official):--account, (that have the) charge, custody, that which...laid up, numbers, office(-r), ordering, oversight, + prison, reckoning, visitation.

H6487.def: from «06485»; a deposit:--that which was delivered (to keep), store.

H6489.def: from «06485»; punishment; Pekod, a symbolic name for Bab.:--Pekod.

H6490.def: or piqqud {pik-kood'}; from «06485»; properly, appointed, i.e. a mandate (of God; plural only, collectively, for the Law):--commandment, precept, statute.

H6491.def: a primitive root; to open (the senses, especially the eyes); figuratively, to be observant:--open.

H6492.def: from «06491»; watch; Pekach, an Israelite king:--Pekah.

H6494.def: from «06491» and «03050»; Jah has observed; Pekachjah, an Israelite king:--Pekahiah.

H6495.def: from «06491» redoubled; opening (of a dungeon), i.e. jail-delivery (figuratively, salvation for sin):--opening of the prison.

H6496.def: from «06485»; a superintendent (civil, military or religious):--which had the charge, governor, office, overseer, (that) was set.

H6497.et: from an unused root meaning to burst
H6497.def: from an unused root meaning to burst; only used as an architectural term of an ornament similar to «06498», a semi-globe:--knop.

H6498.def: from the same as «06497»; the wild cucumber (from splitting open to shed its seeds):--gourd.

H6499.def: or par {pawr}; from «06565»; a bullock (apparently as breaking forth in wild strength, or perhaps as dividing the hoof):--(+ young) bull(-ock), calf, ox.
